cover.sub: Teach for a big brand, build your own, or both

title: Pick by *what you want*
verdict.sub: There is no single best path. Start from what you want next.

rows.need: You want your own brand, app and student list
rows.why: AllCoaching: own domain and Android + iOS app on every plan, 14-day free trial

rows.need: You want students supplied and a regular payout
rows.why: Reach and a set batch; pay and terms come in your offer, not on its website

rows.need: You want reach now and a name of your own later
rows.why: Teach for a brand and build your academy on the side, if your contract allows

rows.need: You want someone else to build the app for you
rows.why: Ask the yearly cost, any fee on sales and who can change the app after launch

title: Start *while you still teach*
switch.sub: Build on the side first, if your contract allows
steps: Check exclusivity and content clauses first
Keep both, or move fully when ready

checks: Tests and notes in one place
